messages.subject: Re: rollSum
parts:
I think the easiest way to get a cumulative sum would be to calculate it outside of ggplot. 

> d.week.c$cumsum<-cumsum(d.week.c$Count)
> d.week.c
    Year Week Count cumsum
1   2000   42     1      1
2   2000   50     1      2
3   2001    5     1      3
4   2001   18     1      4
5   2001   30     1      5


Then you want week by week, but your data has tons of gaps in it and you want R to fill those in? 

My best guess would be to combine the year and week into date format (I do not know how) and then plot time on the x-axis. This should space out your points according to the calendar. 

Brandon
